label: Build a list
description: Build one list from wired values, one input port per item: `List(first: String, second: String) -> (list: List[String])` gives `[first, second]`, in the order the ports are written. Declare the type on the `list` output. Ports are required, so a closed branch skips the node; an item written `name?:` is left out when nothing arrives (no gap, no null).

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: The items in written order. Declare its type: `-> (list: List[String])`.
